rollups.text: Reading interests and books: loves reading and was interested in finding a book club despite a disappointing prior experience (2023-05-20); finished Kristin Hannah's The Nightingale on 2023-01-10 and loved it; bought a leather-bound book journal on 2023-01-18 but had not started using it; admired The Bookish Wanderer's eclectic bookshelves after discovering her on 2023-01-22; added Madeline Miller's The Song of Achilles to the wishlist on 2023-01-25; finished Alex Michaelides's The Silent Patient and loved its twist (date unspecified); interested in twisty psychological thrillers and classical retellings and sought historical-fiction recommendations (2023-05-25).

Creative and practical interests: attended Saturday morning sculpting classes for a few months by 2023-05-24 and found them relaxing and creatively rewarding; experimented at home with air-dry and earthenware clay, finding air-dry more forgiving; considered trying stone carving, collected rocks and stones on hikes as references, and contemplated a small animal figurine and whether to use soapstone, alabaster, marble, or granite. Also developed a geomancy quiz and a comedic fantasy concept about Grog, a goblin dungeon manager.

Also considered a portfolio website and Instagram/Facebook showcases, a printed portfolio book or PDF, further workshops and conferences, and improving front-end coding to build a custom website and photography tools or plugins. Two business-development job opportunities were compared on 2023-05-30. Option A was a role at a reputable real-estate company selling third-party property-management services to multifamily owners and building systems to generate, manage, and advance leads. Option B was a role at a work colleague's real-estate company attracting investors to multifamily properties or a fund and managing investor leads; the colleague was not a close friend but the user felt warmer toward her and recognized Option B might entail more risk. The user said the long-term career goal was to make money and asked for a structured evaluation, one question at a time, with answers compiled into a table or document. Latest state: the options had been clarified, but no decision was recorded.

The conversation covered Italian beef, Chicago-style hot dogs, Polish sausage, jibaritos, popcorn, ribs, pierogi, and other specialties.
